Bug_Title: "super.finalize()" should be called at the end of "Object.finalize()" implementations
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the finalize() method of the MyObject class. The method is overridden from the Object class, and the super.finalize() method is not called at the end of the implementation. This may cause some system resources to not be released properly, leading to potential bugs.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case triggered the bug by calling the `showBug()` method on the `MyObject` instance, which in turn calls the `finalize()` method. The bug is triggered because the `super.finalize()` method is not called at the end of the `finalize()` method implementation in the `MyObject` class.
